title: finding(plugin-detail): record:details read mode draws a multi-line textarea field on one line, though the textarea widget's own read display keeps its line breaks
body:
Filing-gate category: **①, a product defect with a named landing and a reproduction.** `reach:` public door, measured once.

Filed by objectstack's `domain:devx` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#20163, `session_01HRYqpqGcWpJuJkDmbRF75w`). It comes from an out-of-scope finding in objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #21625's browser verification, and that PR's contract review (comment 5973239645) escalated it for filing. ⛔ Not graded here. ⛔ Not claimed.

## Reproduction (the public door)

- **Build:** the Console built at objectui `ab1879721595`, served by `examples/app-showcase` (`pnpm dev -- --fresh --ui --no-watch`, own port, ephemeral DB, seeded admin), in headless Chromium.
- **Steps:**
  1. Set a `showcase_task` record's `notes` (a `textarea` field) to `Call back Monday.\n\nBudget approved, needs legal review.\n` through the data API.
  2. Open the record page.
- **Result:** in `record:details` READ mode the Notes value's `innerText` is `Call back Monday. Budget approved, needs legal review.`, one line with the breaks collapsed. The stored value keeps both line breaks. In EDIT mode the field opens as a multi-line `TEXTAREA` that carries them (objectui#11562, which fixed edit mode only).

## Why it is a defect, not a display choice

objectui's own textarea widget keeps line breaks in its read display: `packages/fields/src/widgets/TextAreaField.tsx:96` (at `ab1879721595`) renders the read-only value in a `whitespace-pre-wrap` block. The same holds for `RichTextField`, comments, replies and the activity timeline. `record:details` read mode does not reach that display, so a multi-line field reads as one paragraph on the record page.

## Where it lands

`packages/plugin-detail`, the read-mode value rendering of `record:details`.

## Dedupe

Read on 2026-10-03:
- **Searched:** every open objectui issue (58), the 370 most recently updated closed ones, and the 30 newest issues, by title, against `textarea|line break|multi-line|newline|whitespace|pre-wrap`.
- **Hits:** one, objectui#11562 (edit mode). Its body and comments do not mention read mode, display, `pre-wrap` or "one line".

## Reader

Triage grades and routes it, presumably to `domain:ui` at objectui (plugin-detail). That lane's seat dispatches the fix.
